description: Create a pull profile under an Endpoint Storage: at boot, Edgegap copies a file or folder from the bucket into the container (maps, configs, large assets kept out of the image). It does nothing until linked to a version with edgegap_link_pull_profile. Avoid destination paths the image already uses.

destination.description: Absolute path in the container, e.g. "/data/maps".

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

source.description: Path in the bucket, starting with "/" and without a trailing "/", e.g. "/maps" or "/config/server.json". Letters, digits, "_", "-", "+" and "." only.

source_type.description: Whether source is a file or a folder.

name: edgegap_create_pull_profile
title: Create a pull profile (copy bucket files into containers)
